AnonymousUserProfile.title: AnonymousUserProfile
AnonymousUserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and preferences for an anonymous user.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and preferences for the app.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

habits.description: The habits the user wants to track (Cigarettes, Weed).

frequency.description: How often the user partakes in the habit.

started.description: When the user started the habit.

packCost.description: The cost of a single pack of the item they are tracking.

itemsPerPack.description: The number of items in a single pack.

singleCost.description: The cost of a single item if bought individually.

itemsPerDay.description: The average number of items consumed per day.

confidence.description: The user's confidence in achieving their goal.

cravingTime.description: When the user's cravings are strongest.

breakDuration.description: Typical duration of a smoke break.

usualPlace.description: Where the user usually engages in the habit.

usualCompany.description: Who the user is usually with.

mainTrigger.description: The biggest reason for the habit.

stressFrequency.description: How often the user feels stressed.

fcmTokens.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

UrgeEntry.title: UrgeEntry
UrgeEntry.description: Represents a single instance of the user logging a smoking urge.

timestamp.description: The exact date and time the urge was logged.

notes.description: Optional user-provided notes about the context of the urge.

type.description: The type of habit logged (e.g. Cigarette, Weed)

moodBefore.description: The user's mood when they logged the urge.

moodAfter.description: The user's mood after logging the urge.

narrative.description: An AI-generated first-person narrative of the moment.

SmokingMoment.title: SmokingMoment
SmokingMoment.description: A user-defined time and label for a recurring smoking habit.

id.description: A unique identifier for the moment.

time.description: The time of the planned smoke, in HH:mm format (e.g., '09:00').

label.description: A short description for the moment (e.g., 'Morning coffee').

completed.description: A map of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to a boolean indicating if the smoke happened.

replacementActivity.description: A map of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to a string describing the replacement activity.

'/users/{userId}'.description: Stores public profile information for each user.

'/users/{userId}/profile/main'.description: A singleton document storing the user's app-specific profile and settings.

'/users/{userId}/urges/{urgeId}'.description: A collection of all smoking urges logged by a specific user.
